fixtures.finding: Inadmissible candidates are excluded before comparison.
Equal-score candidates resolve by canonical key independently of discovery order.
No admissible candidate yields an explicit unresolved result.
Implementation order is not used as a semantic selector.

limitations: Score and canonical_key are candidate fixture fields, not canonical orientation semantics.
Tie-breaking determinism does not establish RT identity or MTO equivalence.
No external or physical orientation interpretation is made.
